editNote: Accepted: level and Price were read off the book's page (the Type line or the item's own header) and match; the text passes the comparison with the page. Kept as category 'other' because a specific magic weapon, armor or shield takes its statistics from the base item its text names, and a cursed item or a structure has no item category of its own in the dataset (the specific-item precedent). Variant headings and the earlier printing's source line are informational. The word 'resilient' links the resilient rune: the source points it at the old magic armor page, which the converter reads as the magic armor record.
